name: Memory
description: A persistent key-value store for buttons — the one thing a face cannot do for itself. A face runs on an opaque origin with no localStorage and no indexedDB, and its local view state dies when the idle window is dismissed, so without a server a button cannot remember anything between presses. Get/set/delete any JSON value, plus increment_value and toggle_value for the two cases buttons actually need (a press counter, a latching toggle). The whole store is also a live resource (resource://memory/store), so a face can bind it and repaint when a value changes.
